purpose: Power-sized, pre-registered prospective out-of-sample (OOS) validation protocol separating adequately powered 2-year primary confirmatory tests (M=2) from long-horizon secondary/exploratory trackers (4-8+ years required for 80% power). All historical 2016-2026 results are strictly treated as exploratory/pseudo-OOS.

stopping_and_evaluation_rules.multiple_testing_primary: Holm-Bonferroni across M=2 primary confirmatory tests (alpha_strict=0.025, FWER<=0.05)
stopping_and_evaluation_rules.multiple_testing_secondary: Holm-Bonferroni across M=5 secondary long-horizon tests (reported with 95% CI; no confirmatory claims before readout week 260)

primary_confirmatory_family_2yr_M2.hypothesis: During weeks with BTCUSDT weekly return <= -5.0%, US BTC Spot ETF USD net flow is lower than during non-crash weeks.
primary_confirmatory_family_2yr_M2.null_rejection_criterion: Two-sided 10,000-permutation Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (M=2) and 95% bootstrap CI strictly < 0 at fixed readout Week 104.

primary_confirmatory_family_2yr_M2.hypothesis: Default ex-RRP 8-variable VAR(2) H=10 spillover (fed_walcl_minus_tga, avoiding RRP<->MMF counterparty overlap) exceeds 1,000-draw Circular Time-Shift Surrogate null (preserving 100% per-series autocorrelation & volatility clustering) on the rolling 156-week window ending at Week 104.

power_analysis.expected_power_at_156w_window_pct: >90% if cross-series coupling persists at >=65% of 2022-2026 magnitude
power_analysis.caveat: Tests reduced-form predictive connectedness only; makes no structural causal claim and freezes no single Top-Transmitter identity.

primary_confirmatory_family_2yr_M2.null_rejection_criterion: Circular-shift surrogate Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (M=2) and tci_z_score > 2.0 at fixed readout Week 104.

secondary_long_horizon_registry_M5.hypothesis: Daily continuous ^MOVE level remains positively associated with daily BIL exact share-creation flow after controlling for SOFR level, delta-SOFR, daily SPY return, and Year FE (Newey-West HAC lag=10).
During weeks with BTCUSDT weekly return <= -5.0%, weekly change in BTC Futures OI is more negative than during non-crash weeks.
During weeks with SPY weekly return <= -2.0%, weekly BIL exact share-creation flow is higher than during non-crash weeks.
During weeks with SPY weekly return <= -2.0%, weekly JNK exact share-creation flow is more negative than during non-crash weeks.
Joint rule (BIL > expanding Q80 AND GLD < expanding Q20) yields Lift > 1.0x for same-week SPY <= -2.0%. Explicitly tracked as severely underpowered over 1-2 years (~9.5 alerts per 104 weeks).

power_analysis.note: Do NOT declare confirmatory pass/fail before >= 35 triggered alerts accumulate.

explicitly_excluded_or_downgraded: Q6 (JNK outflow during calm SPY weeks |r|<=1% -> future SPY crash): unsupported / low power in historical pseudo-OOS.
Q9 (JNK>0 & BIL<=0 during SPY rebound -> 4-week rally continuation): unsupported (Lift 0.97x in historical pseudo-OOS).
Q4a (BIL -> Next-2w WRMFNS): not independently significant after controlling for SOFR and MMF persistence (non-overlapping HAC p=0.2099).
Q5-WRMFNS (MOVE -> WRMFNS ex-COVID/SVB + Year FE): positive point estimate (+1.51B/25pt) but imprecise (SE=0.84, 95% CI [-0.14, +3.17], p=0.0731).
Standalone GLD weekly flow as crash stress indicator (fails Holm-Bonferroni).
Total stablecoin market cap delta as discriminator between internal exchange swap parking vs idle capital (unidentified without exchange reserves).
